test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man covers distances of 819 km, 1476 km, and 1053 km at the speeds of 63 km/hr, x km/hr, and 81 km/hr, respectively. If his average speed for the whole journey is 54 km/hr, then what is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 819 + 1476 + 1053 = 3348 km

Total time = Total distance ÷ Average speed = 3348 ÷ 54 = 62 hours

Time for 1st and 3rd parts = (819 ÷ 63) + (1053 ÷ 81) = 13 + 13 = 26 hours

Time for 2nd part = 62 − 26 = 36 hours

x = 1476 ÷ 36 = 41 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 41 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3685f32de9ffc1e673f679a47be518ba83b7a584fbc4da38e1d82f35d718eec4.png] 

**Given:**

Distances: D₁ = 819 km, D₂ = 1476 km, D₃ = 1053 km

Speeds: S₁ = 63 km/hr, S₂ = x km/hr, S₃ = 81 km/hr

Average Speed (Vₐvg) = 54 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 819 + 1476 + 1053 = 3348 km

⇒ Total Time (T) = 3348 ÷ 54 = 62 hours

⇒ T₁ = 819 ÷ 63 = 13 hours

⇒ T₃ = 1053 ÷ 81 = 13 hours

⇒ T₂ = T − (T₁ + T₃) = 62 − (13 + 13) = 62 − 26 = 36 hours

⇒ Speed x = D₂ ÷ T₂ = 1476 ÷ 36

⇒ x = 41 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 41 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If two equal distances are covered at speeds u and v, then Average Speed = 2uv ÷ (u + v).

Relative Speed

In the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. In the opposite direction, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
